restaurantName: Poll's Kaiserterrasse - Gourmet Restaurant im Weissen Rössl
address: Markt 74, Sankt Wolfgang im Salzkammergut, 5360, Austria
bio: The spectacular lakeside location at Wolfgangsee is one of the main draws of this place. Combined with the stunning views of the lake and mountains, the classically elegant decor and live piano music in the background make for a truly romantic atmosphere. Incorporating local produce and drawing on classic and modern influences, the food is equally impressive. Diners have a choice of three set menus: Poll's Menü, Rössl Menü and Fondue Erlebnis (must be pre-ordered). Overnight accommodation is available at Romantik Hotel Im Weissen Rössl, which also houses this restaurant....
pageTitle: Poll's Kaiserterrasse - Gourmet Restaurant im Weissen Rössl
